notes:
Quick notes from eval — shorthand, fragments: 
- Profile: boutique team focused on JetBrains platform (IntelliJ, PyCharm, GoLand). 80 dev seats across product & platform.
- Primary ask: in-IDE copilot that indexes local repos + monorepos (fast local indexer) and streams completions w/ sub-100ms latency on index hits.
- Wants model/version pinning per project (e.g., repo A -> quantized Llama variant, repo B -> larger model). Pinning + rollback is deal-critical.
- UX: streaming first-token within editor (SSE or websocket) so typing feels instant; incremental token patches preferred over full response.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage monetization; demo wants metrics: token-cost per active dev, expected monthly cost for 80 seats. Target ARR range aligns w/ mid_market estimate.
- Security: cannot send full customer code to hosted LLMs for some repos; will require local index + server-side private deployment (VPC or on-prem). Legal flagged telemetry; need opt-in & retention controls.
- Performance constraints: core requirement: <60ms first-token for local index hit paths on a 4-8 core dev machine OR dedicated/private runtime with pinning. If cannot meet, they will prefer hybrid flow (local index + hosted fallbacks).
- Integration notes: JetBrains plugin must support sandboxing, plugin signing, auto-update. They want minimal native deps; prefer Rust/Java indexer optional but will accept native binary if signed.
- Models: prefer Redwood-verified smaller LMs for cost-sensitive flows; want recomms on quantization + batching for background replication. Also interested in embeddings for code search/ranking.
- POC plan (proposed): 6-week POC, 10 internal dev seats, 2 sample monorepos (200k LOC total), success metrics: mean first-token latency (local hits), median token-cost, false positive completions rate, developer satisfaction survey.
- Quotes: CTO: "We need completions that feel native — if it's laggy devs won't adopt." Product lead: "Model pinning per repo is non-negotiable for our enterprise customers."
- Docs/links: shared POC requirements in Drive + security FAQ requested. Sent initial pricing deck and suggested Dedicated topology (drive link).
- Next immediate step: SE to deliver POC runbook + deployment options (Dedicated vs Private), legal to review telemetry language. AE to confirm POC start date (target week of 2026-03-22).
- Misc: asked about token-level cost breakdown per route, and automatic fallback routing when pinned model unavailable. Raised competition: Sourcegraph (search+code intel), Tabnine (code completion) — they care about low-latency streaming UX more than raw model size.
- Follow-ups: need demo of local indexer memory footprint on Windows (important), sample metrics from previous Redwood jetbrains customers if any, and a short write-up on quantization tradeoffs for code completion.
